title: Monthly Report — ownership and carryover decisions
purpose: Planning and review contract only; this file does not authorize or implement migration or data promotion.

status_definitions.explicit_requirement: Owner meeting/intake explicitly rejects the unsafe behavior. Implementation must conform; may not be on main.
status_definitions.meeting_intent: Source meeting expressed desired reuse, but detailed ownership/promotion/conflict policy remains proposed.
status_definitions.existing_implementation: A verified main-branch code behavior, not independently served acceptance or an owner-wide policy.
status_definitions.proposed_policy: A candidate design for review; NOT authorized for silent promotion, mass rewrite or deployment.
status_definitions.open_decision: Requires an explicit owner/contract decision; preserve current safe behavior, never infer consent.

scope_definitions.contract: One approved contract identity, never another contract.
scope_definitions.site: One confirmed site identity; multi-site use requires explicit membership.
scope_definitions.contract_site: Contract-bounded rows individually linked to confirmed sites; some records may be contract-wide only when explicit.
scope_definitions.report: Pinned report-version item, with optional historical carry context.
scope_definitions.report_month: Evidence only for its exact report month and site selection.
scope_definitions.source_archive: Unmodified source/reference bytes and scoped receipts, not an active report or approved standing default.
scope_definitions.unresolved: No general inheritance scope approved; retain narrower existing site-bound behavior.

global_safety_invariants: A report-only edit changes only its working draft until an explicit shared save; never advances a standing source head.
An Omit/exclude/removed row in a report is not permission to rewrite or delete a contract/site master.
An approved standing update is versioned with an expected revision and does not rewrite prior pinned report history.
No contract B value/artwork/source page may be inherited into contract A; ambiguous membership must require review.
Unresolved site, source date, artwork purpose, pricing or provenance never becomes approved by a passive open/reload.
The prior month may contribute historical context; it does not prove a current-month completion or attachment.
Every original source and previous report version is preserved under any proposed scope migration.

items.label: ENFRA brand logo / approved company identity
items.source: Contract's approved profile/design asset, pinned into a report
items.notes: No other-contract logo; logo is never a cover photograph. Current approved profile assets are profile-bound, not a proven global shared brand rule.

items.label: Client logo and contract terminology
items.notes: No automatic transfer between clients; changing contract identity requires new scope confirmation.

items.label: Report cover photograph
items.source: Selected site's reviewed photograph in a pinned report/version
items.notes: Original aspect ratio and photo role are independently reviewed. Client/ENFRA logos cannot replace cover photography.

items.label: Business-hours outage workflow diagram
items.source: Contract-approved, versioned diagram (not a global ENFRA default)
items.notes: Main at audited SHA still has a global workflow-standards store; PR #533 proposes a contract-specific replacement. No automatic legacy adoption or cross-contract copy.

items.label: After-hours outage workflow diagram
items.source: Contract-approved, versioned diagram (not a global ENFRA default)
items.notes: Absence is a real empty/omitted state, not permission to seed another contract's artwork.

items.label: Organizational chart / site structure
items.source: Approved chart for the confirmed site(s), retained as a pinned report asset
items.notes: An organization-wide diagram is not silently applied to different facilities. Report-only edits do not modify the standing chart.

items.label: Facility contacts and contract contact directory
items.source: Versioned contract directory, contract-wide contacts plus explicit site-bound contacts
items.notes: Match exact saved site identity or uniquely confirmed alias; report edits do not silently reassign a person or overwrite another site's record.

items.label: Thermal capacity: site, plant and service values
items.source: Current code stores versioned contract capacity tables with row-level site_keys; reports pin selected-site snapshots
items.notes: Owner has not approved general contract-wide versus site-level sharing of capacity assumptions. Preserve row/site/plant/service units. No site B refill from site A or numerical inference.

items.label: Subcontractor contacts, trade bands and contact instructions
items.source: Proposed approved contract-level vendor roster, filtered by explicit site exceptions
items.notes: Shared roster promotion is not implemented/approved merely because a report imported a vendor list. Keep source category/trade bands and report-only overrides; see #488/#455.

items.label: Subcontractor status / when to contact
items.source: Proposed contract template plus site-qualified effective status and last-confirmed date
items.notes: Contacts may persist; current service/call status cannot be silently treated as a new-month action. Unknown status remains unknown.

items.label: Priority capital renewal recommendations
items.source: Proposed contract list with row-level site/asset identity; pinned monthly report view
items.notes: Source import alone cannot promote a recommendation to contract master or restore a deliberately deleted row. #544 handles exact-source replays; source dates/history retained.

items.label: Pending and declined proposal items
items.source: Saved report proposal cards/table with source occurrence and status
items.notes: Pending is not Declined; a prior status and date must remain attributable to source/month. A report-only omission is not a permanent contract decision.

items.label: Open equipment issues and evidence/update status
items.source: Report-specific issue cards and source evidence; explicit current-month update confirmation
items.notes: Carry an unresolved issue, not a claim that its old evidence or Updated wording happened again this month. Resolve/omit requires an explicit action.

items.label: Standing staff training requirements / annual status matrix
items.source: Versioned training manifest by contract and site; report retains its own MATRIX_REF copy
items.notes: Current main has contract+site standing matrix; annual-year separation is being worked on in PR #537 and must not be claimed as implemented on main. A completed requirement status does not create an event.

items.label: Completed training sessions (date, topic, participants, hours)
items.source: Period-bound EVENT_REF report table; historic events remain in prior saved snapshots
items.notes: No past session may be relabeled as completed this month; missing date, participants and hours remain unknown. See #496.

items.label: Current-month work orders, service calls and operational narrative
items.source: Selected report's source-bound, site/date-reviewed CMMS or manually entered work
items.notes: One site's totals cannot be used as the other site's; prior month totals are historical, not current. Vendor service PDFs belong in Activity unless onsite work is explicitly ENFRA performed.

items.label: Scorecards, commissioning, water, vendor, progress photos and other attachments
items.source: Immutable source bytes and explicitly selected/reviewed section pages, tied to report period and site
items.notes: Do not carry an included attachment into a new month as freshly produced evidence. No pricing/legal/private pages or unreviewed artwork; approval is occurrence-bound.

items.label: Imported report, uploaded source file and shared reference shelf
items.source: Byte-verified original/source identity; report-specific references and receipts; separate read-only reference shelf
items.notes: Preserve hashes, attribution and original bytes. Storing a reference is never evidence of approved cross-contract reuse; do not purge/publish source files under a scope migration.

steps: Approve A's business-hours diagram explicitly for A.
Create an October A2 report and reuse the approved A diagram.
Create an October B1 report without any B-approved diagram.
expected: A2 may reuse the exact A contract version, pinned into its October report.
B1 must remain empty/ask for B approval, not inherit A artwork.
A September report retains its original version after an A October replacement.

steps: Open October A1 report from its approved contact directory.
Edit one phone number as report-only.
Reopen October A2, September A1, and contract B1 reports.
expected: A1's October report contains the correction only after it is saved.
The shared A directory and A2 stay unchanged until explicit master-save with expected revision.
September A1 and B1 remain unchanged after all operations.

steps: Import vendor trade-band contacts into October A1.
Explicitly promote a reviewed A contract roster at expected revision.
expected: Unreviewed imports do not create standing vendors.
A2 sees the approved A roster only on intentional reuse, with source/trade identity preserved.
A previous A1 version and all contract B records remain pinned and unchanged.

steps: Review A1 chilled-water capacity from exact original source.
Save a contract capacity revision containing A1's explicit site key.
expected: A2 does not inherit A1 numeric values by location guess or schema similarity.
Separate A1 steam/chilled-water and plant/units remain distinct.
The broader capacity reuse policy remains unresolved pending explicit owner decision.

steps: Complete September A1 training event and work-order table.
Create October from saved September report.
Inspect October and then reopen September.
expected: September facts/events remain in the September pinned version.
October does not call September events/work orders 'completed this month'.
Standing approved training requirements remain available without inventing completion.

steps: Correct an October A1 capital recommendation as report-only.
Import the same original again and encounter a conflicting historic row.
Review a Pending and a Declined proposal with source dates.
expected: The intentionally removed or corrected capital row is not silently resurrected.
Reimport conflict keeps current report edits and requires explicit review.
Pending and Declined statuses stay distinct; other contracts and prior snapshots do not change.
